title: Social Gathering (Introductions)
subtitle: Meeting someone for the first time
description: You are at a gathering and someone new comes over to say hello. Work through the exchange one sign at a time.
_draftNote: DRAFT conversational order — pending validation by an SSL teacher (School for the Deaf, Ratmalana). Each turn asks for exactly ONE gloss from the seed vocabulary; the surrounding text is English context describing intent, NOT a claim about SSL sentence structure or word order. The optional partnerGloss fields are hooks for the 3D avatar and are equally unvalidated.

turns.partnerLine: Someone new catches your eye across the room, smiles, and waves at you.
turns.prompt: Greet them back — sign the one that singles out the person you are addressing.
turns.hint: Point clearly towards the person you are greeting, at a natural pace.

turns.partnerLine: They gesture between the two of you — it is time to exchange names.
turns.prompt: Bring up the subject of names.
turns.hint: Keep the handshape steady and let the movement do the work.

turns.partnerLine: They look at you, waiting for you to go first.
turns.prompt: Indicate yourself, so it is clear you are the one being introduced.
turns.hint: Bring the sign in towards your own body rather than out to the side.

turns.partnerLine: You have introduced yourself. Now it is their turn.
turns.prompt: Turn the exchange towards them — the sign that marks something as belonging to the person you are talking to.
turns.hint: Direct the sign towards them, not towards yourself.

turns.partnerLine: They are waiting for your question.
turns.hint: Question signs are usually held a little longer — do not rush it.

turns.partnerLine: They answer, and you would like to know where they are from.
turns.hint: Keep your hand within the camera frame through the whole movement.

turns.partnerLine: The conversation is going well and you want to keep it going.
turns.prompt: Ask about ability — whether something is possible.
turns.hint: Finish the movement fully before dropping your hand.
